morphology.pattern_note: 通常写作 Josie，不按马来语词缀拆分。所列音标为英语人名读音，并非已核定的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 乔西：英语女性名字，常为 Josephine 的昵称；此处按人名解释，原始语料中的具体身份未确定。
senses.en_definition: Josie, a feminine given name, often a familiar form of Josephine; the intended referent in the source data is unknown.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya bentuk mesra bagi nama Josephine; rujukan sebenar dalam data asal belum dikenal pasti.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，正常书写须首字母大写。不能依据词频排名认定为马来语普通词或 DBP 正式词目。以下为人名在马来语句子中的示范搭配，未经语料频率验证。[Oxford：Josie](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/josie)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报；按人名解释的示范
dual_scenarios.ms: Cik Josie akan membentangkan laporan tersebut dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 乔西小姐将在明天的会议上汇报该报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Miss Josie will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友约见；按人名解释的示范
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Josie dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Josie sudah sampai di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Josie arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 对应表示地点的 di。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Josie dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Josie sudah sampai di kafe?
messages.en: Has Josie arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tengah tunggu kita. Jom cepat sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah sampai dan sedang menunggu kita. Marilah kita bergegas sedikit.
messages.zh: 到了，她正等我们呢。走，快一点。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting for us. Come on, let's hurry.

etymology.historical_story: Josie belongs to English personal naming rather than Malay word formation. Oxford identifies it as a familiar form of Josephine. When the name appears in a Malay conversation, it names a person while the surrounding grammar remains Malay. Its presence in a frequency list therefore does not establish an ordinary Malay vocabulary item. [Oxford: Josie](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/josie)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Josie 记成通讯录里的“乔西”：这是人的名字，首字母要大写。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 按本人认可的姓名和读音称呼。正式场合根据身份及本人偏好使用 Cik、Puan 或职衔。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 不能因为 Josie 常为昵称，就擅自把对方姓名改为 Josephine；也不能从名字推断其族群、国籍或宗教。
